If you have questions about your Lone Star Card, call the Lone Star Help Desk at 800-777-7328. The Texas Electronic Benefit Transfer (EBT) system uses the Lone Star Card to provide access to Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) food benefits and Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) cash benefits. The Lone Star Card is used in the same way any other debit card is used. To pay for approved SNAP or TANF items, swipe your Lone Star Card through the store's machine and enter your personal identification number (PIN). The amount of the purchase is taken out of your Lone Star Card account. If you apply and are eligible for TANF or SNAP benefits, you will receive a Lone Star Card from your local Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) benefit office or by mail. To learn more about your EBT Lone Star Card, visit the Lone Star Card - FAQs page or view the Lone Star Card brochure (PDF).

Managing your benefits and Lone Star card is easy by using the Your Texas Benefits mobile app, visiting YourTexasBenefits.com, or by calling the Lone Star Help Desk at 800-777-7328. The Your Texas Benefits app and website provide easy and secure online access to benefits, including SNAP, TANF, Medicaid and the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP). To see if you are eligible for benefits or to locate an HHSC office in your area, visit YourTexasBenefits.com or download the Your Texas Benefits app on Android or Apple devices. With a Your Texas Benefits account you can check your Lone Star Card balance, view recent card activity, manage your PIN, freeze and unfreeze your card, and request a new card using the Your Texas Benefits app. You can also visit YourTexasBenefits.com to view your balance or recent purchases. If you do not have an account, you can set one up on the app or at YourTexasBenefits.com.

Confirmed directly from HHSC's own site — the number is:

**2-1-1** (or **1-877-541-7905** if you can't get through on 2-1-1)

After you connect, pick your language, then **press 2** for benefits help. That's the line that handles YourTexasBenefits.com/SNAP account issues, including getting locked out over security questions. This is confirmed on HHSC's official Lone Star Card Contacts page: call 2-1-1 or 1-877-541-7905, and after you pick a language, press 2.

A couple of practical notes since you're dealing with the security question mess:
- Hours are Monday–Friday, 8am–6pm Central.
- When you get a live person, just tell them straight up you don't remember the exact wording/capitalization of answers you set 5-10 years ago — they can usually verify identity another way (SSN, DOB, case number) and reset the questions entirely instead of making you guess.
- Don't keep guessing wrong on the account itself — repeated failed attempts can lock you out further, so save the guessing for the human on the phone.
